name: 04-thinking-and-tools
description: How the agent reports thinking and generic tool calls, with filesystem capability advertised so it uses client tools rather than its own shell.

prompt.text: Think step by step. Read README.md in this directory, then write a file notes.md containing exactly one sentence summarizing it. Do not ask for confirmation.

steps.note: Yields agent_thought_chunk plus tool_call and tool_call_update with their kinds, status progression, and content block shapes.
